title: DEC-240 CI hardening: job-level npm_config_ignore_scripts on every job that runs npm (OMARK-106 AC 3)
description: Ruled by opum-doc 2026-11-17 (option A), relayed by the leader. Set job-level env npm_config_ignore_scripts: "true" on every job in .github/workflows that runs npm, so the lint in scripts/test/workflow-hardening.test.mjs becomes a backstop rather than the only control. Any job that genuinely needs a dependency lifecycle script opts out explicitly with the reason written in the workflow. Supersedes OMARK-106 LOW-2 (more npm subcommands, quoted/path-prefixed npm) and LOW-3 (per-command and comment-stripped scanning): three review rounds on #243 showed a line scanner trades evasions for new ones, and the environment variable closes the class. Floor tier: Sonnet writer, Opus review. The fixtures the dropped scanner caught and dev line rule does not are listed in an implementation note on this task, as the cases the env var closes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: every job that runs npm sets npm_config_ignore_scripts: "true" at job level, and the suite reads the real workflows to prove it
a job that opts out names the reason in the workflow and the suite pins the opt-out list
the dropped LOW-2/LOW-3 evasions are demonstrated closed by the variable (a marker-file control run with npm_config_ignore_scripts set), not by the lint

implementationNotes:
FIXTURES MOVED FROM #243 (cases the dropped LOW-2/LOW-3 scanner caught and dev's line rule does not; the env var is what closes them, so prove them closed with a marker-file control, not with the lint): 'LOW-3: the flag on one command, a later npm rebuild without it (&&)': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm rebuild
')] || 'LOW-3: the flag only inside a trailing comment': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: npm install x # --ignore-scripts
')] || 'LOW-2: npm update': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: npm update
')] || 'LOW-2: npm dedupe': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: npm dedupe
')] || 'LOW-2: npm audit fix': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: npm audit fix
')] || 'LOW-2: npm link': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: npm link
')] || 'LOW-2: npm ic': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: npm ic
')] || 'LOW-2: npm sit': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: npm sit
')] || 'LOW-2: a quoted npm': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: "npm" ci
')] || 'LOW-2: a path-prefixed npm': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: /usr/bin/npm ci
')] || 'LOW-2: a node_modules/.bin npm': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: ./node_modules/.bin/npm ci
')] || 'B2: a backticked npm ci': ['without --ignore-scripts', wrap('      - name: i
        run: x=`npm ci`
')] || ['npm run ci (a script named ci, not npm ci)', 'npm run ci'] || ['a subshell npm ci with the flag', '(cd sub && npm ci --ignore-scripts)']

CORRECTION to the moved-fixtures note (round-4 review of #243): of the 14 moved fixtures, 12 are rejecting cases dev does not catch (the env var closes those). The other two are ACCEPTING fixtures that dev rejects as FALSE POSITIVES, not evasions: `npm run ci` (dev matches \sci\b) and `(cd sub && npm ci --ignore-scripts)` (the token is --ignore-scripts)). They are lint false positives to weigh, not cases the variable closes.

DELIVERED. ci.yml: job-level env npm_config_ignore_scripts: "true" on all three npm-running jobs (manifest, lore-check, tracker). workflow-hardening.test.mjs: a job rule (a job that runs npm or installs setup-node must set the variable true at job level; any other value anywhere is an opt-out refused unless file:job is in the pinned, empty OPT_OUTS list and carries an `opt-out reason:` line above; flow-style env refused), 8 rejecting and 5 accepting fixtures plus 3 real-workflow controls; removing the env from ci.yml turns exactly the 3 job checks red. install-ignore-scripts.test.sh: arm 3 shows the variable alone (no flag) keeps a failing postinstall from running, with arm 2 (the variable set false, scoped by env to that one npm) as its control that the script DOES run. NOT CLAIMED: locally this ran on npm 12, which blocks dependency scripts by default, so arm 3 is only meaningful on the CI npm (setup-node 24), where arm 2 proves scripts run; read the CI run, not the local pass. The 12 moved rejecting fixtures are closed by the variable class-wide (arm 3), not individually re-run through the lint.
